title: peer answers on 135 as well: ACL is wider than intended
titleZh: 对端在 135 上也有响应:ACL 比预期宽
why: The designed ACL allows exactly one path (client -> server tcp:443). A reachable 135 means the ACL is too wide. It is a real finding but not a link-breaking one, so it must be degraded - the middle state between pass and blocked.
inject: TCP probe result for 203.0.113.5:135 replaced by 'connected'
